# contentful_locale (List Resource)

Lists Contentful Locales in an existing space and environment. Results follow Contentful's response order; no sort order is guaranteed.

Use this query in a `.tfquery.hcl` file with Terraform 1.14 or later. See [Discover and import existing resources](../guides/resource-discovery) to generate configuration from the results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "contentful_locale" "locales" {
  provider = contentful

  config {
    space_id       = var.contentful_space_id
    environment_id = var.contentful_environment_id
  }

  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment from which to list Locales.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space from which to list Locales.
